# BonzAI v4.0.1 RC

A release candidate for a more personal, coordinated creative workspace.

### Companions with a story
- Scene-specific quests, gifts and six-heart relationship progression.
- Relationship tracks that can continue across scenes or start fresh.
- Redesigned roleplay controls, heartbeat settings and social drafts.
- New square, borderless portraits for the built-in companions.

### A workspace that works together
- Shared local inference coordination for chat, roleplay media and workflow workers.
- Interactive work takes priority over waiting background jobs; active requests finish before handoff.
- Idle model unloading reduces overlapping memory use. Model-family switches can require reloading.
- More consistent page headers, spacing, typography and theme choices.

### Measure, create and personalize
- Local performance recording, hardware reports and selectable benchmark scenarios.
- Revised audio studio and 3D creation, inspection and game-runtime improvements.
- Dataset curation and clearer training artifacts, labeled by media type.
- Training and Uncensor remain distinct experiences.

### Optional ownership and markets
- Shared locked-liquidity vault architecture for agent, model and game tokens.
- Fee collection and stakeholder distributions remain separate from workflow payments.
- Public protocol configuration template and GitHub configuration support.

### Installation and RC limitations
Complete DMG, EXE and DEB installers are hosted on R2. Platform download links and SHA-256 manifests are added below after successful builds; no split-file reconstruction is required.

This is prerelease software. Back up important local data before testing. Native GPU inference still needs validation on the target hardware. The shared inference queue does not guarantee that an individual generation fits in available memory.

Onchain deployment addresses are not configured in this release: ownership, token issuance and paid protocol settlement require a configured deployment. Local inference remains usable without a wallet. Windows installers are unsigned.
